coordinateSystem: top-left origin; x and y are percent of canvas; regions estimated by visual inspection
firstVisualFocus: upper-left two-line black headline, followed by the large white line-drawn guide pointing to the real person's small object
primaryMechanism: photo and white-filled hand drawing interact across the frame; pointing hand links the held evidence object to a lower line-drawn scenario
dominantAxis: headline horizontal; guide's gaze and finger diagonal to the real person's hand and lower scenario
primaryFocus: large two-line headline and the contrast between the real person and drawn guide
readingPath: real person's held object and face
lower drawn house and real trees

heldObject.role: small concrete evidence and interaction target

foregroundScenario.role: line-drawn house and courtyard that grounds the topic

background.leftUpper: light neutral photo wall and protected text field

visualMass.rightGuide: largest single white form, roughly 35-45% width and 75% height
visualMass.headline: roughly 13-17% visible area

paletteRoles.accent: small real skin, clothing and foliage areas; exact hues adaptive

material.drawing: slight hand-line wobble, variable dark ink width and solid off-white fill
material.title: thin sharp Chinese strokes, solid dark fill, no shadow
